title: Beyond Surface Forms: Symbolic Edits as a Test for Logical Reasoning with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.30256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Logical reasoning with large language models (LLMs) is a critical capability, as it reflects a system's ability to correctly deduce hypotheses from a given context using faithful deductive processes. However, LLM reasoning has often been shown to be sensitive to small surface-level variations in problem formulation, raising questions about whether models truly follow the underlying logical structure. Studying this behavior is challenging because the symbolic components of logical problems, such as operators and predicates, are difficult to systematically manipulate in natural language. We introduce a tool-driven framework for generating controlled, label-preserving edits to logical reasoning problems. Our method operates on symbolic representations of first-order logic and constraint satisfaction problem tasks, enabling targeted modifications to logical operators and other structural components before translating them back into natural

translated_title: 超越表面形式：符号编辑作为大语言模型逻辑推理能力的测试方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的逻辑推理是一项关键能力，因为它反映了系统通过忠实的演绎过程从给定上下文中正确推导出假设的能力。然而，已有研究一再表明，大语言模型的推理对问题表述中微小的表面变化十分敏感，这引发了模型是否真正遵循底层逻辑结构的疑问。研究这种行为具有挑战性，因为逻辑问题中的符号组件（如算子和谓词）在自然语言中难以进行系统性的操作。我们提出了一个工具驱动的框架，用于对逻辑推理问题生成受控的、保持标签不变的编辑。我们的方法作用于一阶逻辑和约束满足问题任务的符号表示，能够对逻辑算子和其他结构组件进行针对性修改，然后再将其转换回自然语言。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个工具驱动的框架，通过在一阶逻辑和约束满足问题的符号表示上进行受控的、保持答案标签不变的编辑，系统性检验大语言模型的逻辑推理是否真正依赖底层逻辑结构而非表面表述形式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a tool-driven framework that generates controlled, label-preserving edits on symbolic representations of first-order logic and constraint satisfaction problems, enabling systematic testing of whether LLMs' logical reasoning truly relies on underlying logical structure rather than surface-level formulations.
